description: This source file defines a SwiftUI extension for tracking view width changes using PreferenceKey, along with a testing utility within a debug build configuration.

classes.name: ViewWidthPreferenceKey

classes.description: An extension to SwiftUI's View protocol providing a method to observe width changes.
